subject: Curtis-Tufts School Co-Location
overview: The subcommittee met to consider co-locating the Curtis-Tufts therapeutic program with the Medford High School campus as part of future facility planning. The committee voted to recommend co-localizing Curtis-Tufts with the main high school campus to the full School Committee.

items.title: Curtis-Tufts School Co-Location Proposal
items.summary: District staff, school administrators, and committee members discussed the educational benefits, operational needs, and facility considerations of co-locating the Curtis-Tufts therapeutic program with the main Medford High School campus. The committee approved a motion to recommend co-localizing Curtis-Tufts with the Medford High School campus.
